verdict.rationale: Issuing API credentials to an agent is a fair question for a deployment platform with a REST API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents scoped or least-privilege tokens. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: team-level access and secrets management, connecting AI assistants to an account, and AI Gateway removing the need to manage model API keys.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
